const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair-w67-validate.lua
+local function load_records(path)
+  local records = {}
+  local current_section = nil
+  _G.section = function(value) current_section = value end
+  _G.t = function(source, target, source_tag, args_order)
+    records[#records + 1] = {
+      section = current_section,
+      source = source,
+      target = target,
+      source_tag = source_tag,
+      args_order = args_order,
+    }
+  end
+  assert(loadfile(path))()
+  return records
+end
+
+local function compare(baseline_path, current_path)
+  local baseline = load_records(baseline_path)
+  local current = load_records(current_path)
+  assert(#baseline == #current, current_path .. ": record count changed")
+  local changed = {}
+  for i = 1, #baseline do
+    local before, after = baseline[i], current[i]
+    assert(before.section == after.section, current_path .. ": section changed at record " .. i)
+    assert(before.source == after.source, current_path .. ": source changed at record " .. i)
+    assert(before.source_tag == after.source_tag, current_path .. ": source_tag changed at record " .. i)
+    assert(before.args_order == after.args_order, current_path .. ": args_order changed at record " .. i)
+    if before.target ~= after.target then
+      changed[#changed + 1] = { before = before, after = after }
+    end
+  end
+  return changed
+end
+
+local mod_changes = compare(arg[1], arg[2])
+local cults_changes = compare(arg[3], arg[4])
+assert(#mod_changes == 1, "mod-tome.lua must have exactly one changed target")
+assert(#cults_changes == 1, "tome-cults.lua must have exactly one changed target")
+
+local mod = mod_changes[1]
+assert(mod.before.source == "%s talent %s (+%d level(s))")
+assert(mod.before.target == "%s 技能 %s (+%d 等级)")
+assert(mod.after.target == "%s技能 %s（+%d 级）")
+
+local cults = cults_changes[1]
+assert(cults.before.source:find("Quekorja was the god of time and possibilities", 1, true))
+local expected = cults.before.target
+expected = expected:gsub("安格列文", "安格利文", 1)
+expected = expected:gsub("并指派了自己的记录者来记录它的故事", "并指派了自己的图书管理员来记录它的故事", 1)
+expected = expected:gsub("有观点认为这些记录其实是来自别的时间线", "有观点认为这些记录可能来自别的时间线", 1)
+assert(cults.after.target == expected, "cults target contains an unexpected change")
+
+print("PASS: LuaJIT loaded 4 files")
+print("PASS: exactly 2 records changed relative to baseline; target fields only")
+print("PASS: current targets equal the three authorized window-67 edits")
*** End Patch";
